pkgmetadata.longdescription: Crawlee is a web scraping and browser automation library for Python. It supports HTTP crawling via Parsel, BeautifulSoup, httpx, and browser automation via Playwright, with built-in proxy rotation and data extraction.

use.flag: Enable BeautifulSoup4 and html5lib crawling support
Enable curl-cffi HTTP client with browser impersonation
Enable PostgreSQL storage via asyncpg and SQLAlchemy
Enable SQLite storage via aiosqlite and SQLAlchemy
